title: Sable and the Verdict
author: Elodie Montrose
blurb: Dominic Iversen, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
